description: This Java test class, DrugValidatorTest, contains unit tests for the DrugValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It verifies validation logic for Drug objects, including cases of null checks, duplicate mappings, and field length constraints.

classes.name: DrugValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DrugValidator, testing validation scenarios for Drug objects within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: executeDrugMappingsDataSet
methods.description: Initializes test data by executing the XML data set for drug mappings before each test.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheDrugObjectIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails with an IllegalArgumentException when the Drug object is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfDrugOnDrugReferenceMapIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation error when a DrugReferenceMap within Drug has a null Drug reference.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptReferenceTermOnDrugReferenceMapIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if a DrugReferenceMap within Drug has a null ConceptReferenceTerm.

methods.name: validate_shouldInvokeConceptReferenceTermValidatorIfTermOnDrugReferenceMapIsNew
methods.description: Tests that the validator calls the ConceptReferenceTerm validator when the term is new.

methods.name: validate_shouldInvokeConceptMapTypeValidatorIfConceptMapTypeOnDrugReferenceMapIsNew
methods.description: Tests that the validator calls the ConceptMapType validator when the type is new.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectDrugMultipleMappingsToTheSameTerm
methods.description: Checks that multiple mappings to the same ConceptReferenceTerm are rejected.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Validates that a proper Drug object passes validation without errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Ensures that correctly sized string fields do not produce validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Ensures that overly long string fields trigger length validation errors.
